# EfficientNet-B4

Classification · `efficientnet-b4_380x380` · DX-APP Python example

Classification model, evaluated on ILSVRC2012.

**Input** 380 × 380 × 3 · **Dataset** ILSVRC2012 · **License** BSD-3-Clause · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![EfficientNet-B4 output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models EfficientNetB4
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/efficientnet-b4_380x380/efficientnet-b4_380x380_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/efficientnet-b4_380x380.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target efficientnet-b4_380x380_sync   # once
./bin/efficientnet-b4_380x380_sync \
  -m assets/models/efficientnet-b4_380x380.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 83.39 |
| Q-Lite | 81.99 (−1.40) |
| Q-Pro | 82.79 (−0.60) |
